name: Pocket Markwhen
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Keeps CRLF line endings in .mw files so that the source view does not rewrite a file that you only open.
changes_user: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Just opening a timeline file no longer rewrites its line endings.
tip: Select Today to jump to the first event on or after the current day.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Pocket Markwhen is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for keeping it in your editor.
